meta_relentless_starfall_diamond.name: Relentless Starfall Diamond
meta_relentless_starfall_diamond.describe: +3% critical strike damage. Requires at least 2 red and 2 yellow and 2 blue gems.

meta_chaotic_starfall_diamond.name: Chaotic Starfall Diamond
meta_chaotic_starfall_diamond.describe: +3% spell critical damage. Requires at least 2 blue gems.

meta_powerful_starfall_diamond.name: Powerful Starfall Diamond
meta_powerful_starfall_diamond.describe: 5% chance to resist a stun. Requires at least 3 blue gems.

meta_insightful_starfall_diamond.name: Insightful Starfall Diamond
meta_insightful_starfall_diamond.describe: Your spells have a chance to restore mana. Requires at least one red, one yellow and one blue gem.

meta_bracing_starfall_diamond.name: Bracing Starfall Diamond
meta_bracing_starfall_diamond.describe: 2% less threat. Requires more red gems than blue gems.

meta_eternal_starfall_diamond.name: Eternal Starfall Diamond
meta_eternal_starfall_diamond.describe: +10% shield block value. Requires at least 2 blue and 1 yellow gems.
